items.usage: Use on a patient (any limb) with item condition >= 50. Not consumed. If a Blank Donor Card (bloodcollector) or a donor card is loaded, it is consumed and a blood-type card is placed in the patient's ID card slot (or in the analyzer).

items.summary: Hematology Analyzer: prints the patient's blood type and blood-related readings (sepsis, immunity, acidosis/alkalosis, bloodloss, bloodpressure and drug levels like afsaline, afadrenaline, afantibiotics, afopioid...). items.usage: Use on patient (any limb). Consumed; gives the user an emptybloodpack. Compatibility is checked against the patient's blood type (antigens A, B, Rh; antibloodloss2 is O-negative = universal donor).

conditional: pack tagged acid:N (donor was acidotic)

items.usage: Use on the Torso with retractedskin (>=99) after the old liver was cut out (liverremoved) or freed with the organ scalpel (liverswap). Consumed when it replaces a removed organ; on a swap the patient's old organ is returned as an item if it was <90% damaged. NOTE: liver code applies -workcondition twice when the liver was removed (damage 100), and on a swap with old damage >=90 the transplant item is not removed (looks like a bug; unverified in game).

skill.notes: Failing reduces effective organ quality by 40 (workcondition = item condition - 40). Surgery skill = medical skill unless Neurotrauma Surgery Plus (NTSP) is enabled, then max(surgery, medical/4). Skill checks are probabilistic: success chance = skill/required (capped at 100%), unless config NT_VanillaSkillCheck is on.

treats.amount: -item condition (removed organ) or set to 100 - condition (swap)

causes.amount: -(condition/5) on removed organ, or +((100-old damage)-condition)/5 on swap

causes.when: conditional: organ rejection roll (chance (immunity-10)/150 x talent multiplier) when config NT_organRejection is on

items.onFailure: Low skill makes the new organ work as if 40% more damaged.
items.summary: Transplants a new liver. Open the torso, use the liver organ scalpel, then apply. Keep immunity low (immunosuppressant) to avoid rejection; organ quality is the item condition, which rots outside refrigeration.
items.notes: Same function registered for the _q1 (lower quality/cheaper) variant.

items.usage: Use on patient; requires a charged battery inside. 5 s cooldown. Each shock drains battery 20 (10 for fulgurium cell). Effect lands after 2 s.

skill.notes: Cardiac-arrest fix chance = clamp(medical/200, 20%, 40%).

items.summary: Automatic defibrillator: reliably fixes fibrillation/tachycardia regardless of skill and has a 20-40% chance per shock to restart a stopped heart. Safe to use - it won't shock a normal rhythm.
items.name: Automated External Defibrillator

no existing incision on the limb; surgery skill 30
surgeryincision >= 99 (grows over time; strength starts at 1+skill/2)

steps.action: Close: clears surgeryincision, clampedbleeding, retractedskin, caviclean + fixes conditions on that limb

steps.action: Amputates the limb surgically, gives limb item (rarm/larm/rleg/lleg/headsa) unless already amputated or gangrene >= 15

surgeryProcedures.name: Limb reattachment

steps.action: Clears sawedbones and the surgical amputation

surgeryProcedures.notes: Do not suture before attaching - suturing with sawedbones amputates.

surgeryProcedures.name: Organ transplant / swap (liver, heart, lungs, kidneys)

steps.action: Free the organ: <organ>swap = 100 (or <organ>removed if organ is 100% dead)
Insert new organ; returns the old organ item if it was < 90% damaged (kidneys < 45%)

surgeryProcedures.notes: Heart swap sets cardiacarrest 100 (restart with AED/defibrillator); lung swap sets respiratoryarrest 100 (ventilate/BVM). Immunity drives rejection (config NT_organRejection) - give immunosuppressant. Using the organ scalpel a second time while in swap state extracts the organ instead.

surgeryProcedures.name: Organ harvesting
surgeryProcedures.goal: Remove an organ to obtain an organ item

steps.action: Second cut: organ removed, damage set 100, organ item given (condition 100 - damage) if damage < 90

surgeryProcedures.notes: Kills/cripples the donor: heart -> cardiacarrest, lungs -> respiratoryarrest, brain -> neurotrauma +100. Organs are placed into a container held in hand if it has room.

surgeryProcedures.name: Brain transplant

steps.action: Extract brain item (player detached into item on server)
steps.requires: Head retractedskin; donor neurotrauma < 90 for usable brain

steps.action: Leads to brainremoved if recipient neurotrauma >= 100, otherwise extract

steps.requires: Head retractedskin; brainremoved; surgery 100 for full quality

Clears arterialcut, carotidarterialcut, internalbleeding, stroke, tourniqueted on that limb
